country_inclusion: point covered by pinned Haiti boundary; polygon positive-area intersection
department_assignment: source point, or interior representative point of country-clipped polygon; ambiguous/unmatched retained
name_normalization: Unicode NFKD, remove combining marks, casefold, replace non-alphanumeric characters with spaces, collapse whitespace
duplicate_checks: point covered by polygon within theme
repeated normalized nonblank name within theme
cross_source_check: PAHO or CNIGS-school name equal to normalized OSM name within theme: retain all pairs and distance to geometry; no distance acceptance cutoff
